props.gloss_en: Rav Chisda: the dispute is about the androginos; but about the tumtum all agree it is a doubt, and it is holy out of doubt
the baraita: 'the male' (Lev 27:3) -- and not a tumtum or an androginos [in valuations]
delete the tumtum from here [from the Erchin baraita]
(entertained by the baraita) they might not be valued as a man but be valued as a woman
the verse says 'the male ... and if a female' (Lev 27:3-4) -- and not a tumtum or an androginos
delete the tumtum from here [from the second clause of the Erchin baraita]
the baraita: 'whether male or female' (Lev 3:1) -- a definite male, a definite female, and not a tumtum or an androginos
delete the tumtum from here [from the shelamim baraita]
the baraita: 'a male' -- not a female; when it says 'a male' below, which it need not say, why does it say it? to exclude a tumtum and an androginos
delete the tumtum from here [from the olah baraita]
the baraita's first tanna: the worshipped, the set-aside, the harlot's fee, the dog's price, and a tumtum and an androginos -- all render garments impure in the throat
R' Eliezer: a tumtum and an androginos do not render garments impure in the throat
R' Eliezer: wherever 'male and female' is said, you exclude a tumtum and an androginos from among them
R' Eliezer: and a bird, since 'male and female' is not said of it, you do not exclude a tumtum and an androginos from among them
delete the tumtum from here [from the beit-habliah baraita]
R' Elazar: the tereifa, kilayim, the one born by caesarean, tumtum and androginos -- are not holy and do not sanctify
and Shmuel said: not holy by substitution, and they do not sanctify to make a substitute
delete the tumtum from here [from R' Elazar's list]
R' Elazar: FIVE are not holy and do not sanctify -- the tereifa, kilayim, the caesarean-born, the tumtum and the androginos
take out the tumtum and put in the orphan [in R' Elazar's five]
R' Ilai in R' Yishmael's name: an androginos is a firstborn, and its blemish is with it
and the Sages say: no sanctity takes hold of it
RSBY in R' Shimon's name: it says 'the male' (Deut 15:19), and wherever 'male' is said it is only to exclude a tumtum and an androginos

(entertained) the baraita's dispute is over the tumtum: the first tanna holds it a doubt and holy out of doubt; RSBY comes to say it is a distinct entity and not holy (deleting the tumtum would make RSBY the same as the Rabbis)
no: all agree the tumtum is not in doubt as a distinct entity; it is male-or-female that is in doubt
[a tumtum] urinating at the place of the male organ -- all agree it is male
they dispute [a tumtum] urinating at the female place: one master is concerned lest its male organ was turned to its female place, and one master is not
R' Elazar ruled: an animal [firstborn tumtum] urinating at the female place -- is chullin
R' Yochanan wondered: who is it that disregards the first tanna and R' Yishmael?
that is what he is saying: who leaves two and acts like one?
and R' Elazar -- like whom does he hold? like what Reish Lakish said
Reish Lakish: they called the tumtum a doubt only in a human, since its male and female [places] are in one place
Reish Lakish: but an animal -- urinating at the male place, it is male
Reish Lakish: urinating at the female place, it is female
since it has changed [in one respect], it has changed [in another]
baraita A: a tumtum who betrothed -- his betrothal is a betrothal; who was betrothed -- the betrothal is a betrothal
baraita A: and he performs chalitza, and they perform chalitza for his wife, and they perform yibum with his wife
baraita B: the wife of a tumtum performs chalitza and does not enter yibum
R' Akiva: a congenital eunuch neither performs chalitza nor yibum
(assumed) both baraitot follow R' Akiva
(entertained) the baraitot dispute 'since it changed, it changed': the one allowing yibum does not say it, the one forbidding yibum does
this [baraita A] is R' Eliezer
and that [baraita B] is R' Akiva
(candidate) the tanna is R' Yehuda
R' Yehuda: a tumtum who was torn open and found male does not perform chalitza, for he is like a saris
rather it is R' Yosei b'R' Yehuda
R' Yosei b'R' Yehuda: a tumtum does not perform chalitza, lest he be torn open and found a congenital eunuch
he says 'perhaps': perhaps he will be torn and found female; or, if male, perhaps he will be found a congenital eunuch
what is between them? Rava: to disqualify [the widow, by his chalitza] where there are [other] brothers
Rava: and to perform chalitza where there are no [other] brothers -- that is between them

כי הא דהורה רבי אלעזר: בבהמה מטיל מים במקום נקבות -- חולין (an instance of the not-concerned side; kind approximate, the marker is כי הא)
דתניא: רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה אומר: טומטום לא חולץ, שמא יקרע וימצא סריס חמה

frames.gloss_en: ומאן תנא אליבא דרבי עקיבא? -- who is the tanna who follows R' Akiva and requires chalitza of the tumtum's wife?

eliminated_by.gloss_en: הא ודאי סריס משוי ליה! דתנן: רבי יהודה אומר: טומטום שנקרע ונמצא זכר -- לא יחלוץ, מפני שהוא כסריס (p_ry_nikra_zachar_lo_yachlotz)

objections.gloss_en: אלא מעתה בערכין יערך? אלמה תניא: הזכר -- ולא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס! -- if the tumtum is [certainly male or female, only] in doubt, it should be valuated
תא שמע: יכול ... בערך אשה? ת"ל הזכר ... אם נקבה, ולא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס!
תא שמע: אם זכר אם נקבה -- זכר ודאי נקבה ודאית, ולא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס
תא שמע: הזכר -- ולא נקבה; 'זכר' below, which need not be said -- להוציא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס

תא שמע: the worshipped ... and a tumtum and androginos all render garments impure in the throat; R' Eliezer: tumtum and androginos do not ... a bird, of which 'male and female' is not said, you do not exclude them! (Steinsaltz: the first tanna treats the tumtum bird as unfit, i.e. not a doubtful male or female)
תא שמע: R' Elazar: tereifa, kilayim, yotze dofen, tumtum and androginos -- not holy and do not sanctify; and Shmuel: in temura
תא שמע: R' Elazar: FIVE are not holy and do not sanctify ... tumtum and androginos. וכי תימא הכא נמי סמי מיכן טומטום -- הוו להו ארבעה! (the deletion answer is pre-empted: the count is five)
תהי בה רבי יוחנן: מאן דלא חש לתנא קמא ולרבי ישמעאל? -- R' Elazar's ruling sets aside those who treat the tumtum as a doubt

answered_by.gloss_en: ורבי אלעזר כמאן סברה? כי הא דאמר ריש לקיש: the tumtum is a doubt only in a human; an animal urinating at the female place is female (= p_relazar_kereish_lakish)

objections.gloss_en: ולימא רבי יוחנן נמי: מאן דלא חש לרבנן בתראי? דאמר רב חסדא: בטומטום דברי הכל ספיקא!

answered_by.gloss_en: רבי יוחנן לא סבירא ליה דרב חסדא (= r_yochanan's deny commit on p_rch_tumtum_safek)

objections.gloss_en: אי לא סבירא ליה, לימא הוא דאמר כרבנן בתראי? -- then R' Elazar has a tanna; why wonder at him?

answered_by.gloss_en: הכי נמי קאמר: מאן שביק תרי ועביד כחד! (= p_ry_shavek_trei)

objections.gloss_en: מתקיף לה רב אושעיא: וליחוש שמא נהפכה זכרותו לנקבותו!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר ליה: כמאן? כרבי מאיר דחייש למיעוטא?! [Countered at 42b.7 by Abaye bar Avin and Rav Chananya bar Avin -- אפילו תימא רבנן, הואיל ואישתני אישתני -- which the schema cannot attach to an answer; see header]

objections.gloss_en: אטו כל דמיקרע זכר משתכח, נקבה לא משתכח? -- why only the fear of a saris chama?

answered_by.gloss_en: שמא קאמר: שמא יקרע וימצא נקבה, אי נמי זכר נמי, שמא ימצא סריס חמה (= p_rybry_shema_nekeva_o_saris)
